question:
**Select the correctly spelt option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

__Patrrol__ is very costly these days.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Petrol.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **The correct spelling of the word is "Petrol", not "Patrrol" or any other variations.**
 
• **"Petrol" is a noun that refers to a flammable liquid used as fuel for internal combustion engines.**(तेल)
 
• The given sentence implies that the cost of petrol has increased recently.
 
• The correct usage of "petrol" in a sentence would be: "I need to fill up my car with petrol before I go on a long drive."
 
• The other spellings given in options 1, 2 and 3 are incorrect.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
